title: Causally Constrained and Uncertainty-Aware Cardiopulmonary Risk Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.17819v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Routine chest computed tomography (CT) captures pulmonary, cardiac, and vascular phenotypes that jointly stratify lung cancer and cardiovascular disease, the two leading causes of death in lung-screening populations. Yet clinical risk calculators evaluate each disease in isolation and omit CT findings, whereas unconstrained machine learning overfits small hospital cohorts, learns treatment- and illness-confounded risk directions, and conceals uncertainty when patient records are incomplete. Here we present the Causal Envelope Agent (CE-Agent), a two-stage framework that compiles peer-reviewed epidemiological evidence into explicit constraints on risk-factor weights before any outcome is seen, while estimating local baseline risk and newly added CT phenotypes from cohort data. At deployment, closed-form uncertainty propagation accounts for missing clinical or CT inputs within milliseconds per patient, running over two orders of magnitude

translated_title: 因果约束与不确定性感知的心肺风险预测
translated_abstract: 常规胸部计算机断层扫描（CT）能够捕捉肺部、心脏和血管表型，这些表型共同用于肺癌与心血管疾病的风险分层——这两者是肺癌筛查人群中最主要的死亡原因。然而，临床风险计算器对每种疾病进行孤立评估且忽略CT发现，而无约束的机器学习则会在小型医院队列上过拟合，学习到受治疗和疾病混淆的风险方向，并在患者记录不完整时隐藏不确定性。在此，我们提出了因果包络智能体（CE-Agent），这是一个两阶段框架，在观察到任何结局之前，将经同行评审的流行病学证据编译为风险因素权重的显式约束，同时从队列数据中估计局部基线风险和新加入的CT表型。在部署阶段，闭式不确定性传播能够以每位患者数毫秒的速度处理缺失的临床或CT输入，运行效率高出两个数量级。
tldr: 提出因果包络智能体（CE-Agent）框架，通过将流行病学证据转化为显式因果约束并融合CT表型与闭式不确定性传播，实现对肺癌与心血管疾病的联合风险预测，并能快速处理缺失数据。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Causal Envelope Agent (CE-Agent), a two-stage causally constrained framework that compiles epidemiological evidence into explicit risk-factor constraints and integrates CT phenotypes with closed-form uncertainty propagation for joint lung cancer and cardiovascular risk prediction with millisecond-level handling of missing data.
